description: TEST FIXTURE for trusted_programs (decomposed-level trusted-program allowlist, Option B). Minimal config: only keys needed to classify command strings.
_comment_fixture: Isolated TDD fixture for the trusted_programs feature. trusted_programs is matched AFTER decomposition against each sub-command's program token (the & call-target / first token). A match grants 'allow' for that sub-command ONLY IF no modifying command appears in its arguments or sibling statements (Option B: args are scanned; unknown args are ignored).
_comment_intercept_tool_name: Only Bash is intercepted by this minimal fixture.
_comment_tool_name_mapping: Bash command string lives at tool_input.command.
_comment_ignore_tool_name: No tools ignored in this minimal fixture.
_comment_trusted_programs: Programs trusted to run. Matched AFTER decomposition, against the program token of each decomposed sub-command. A match grants 'allow' for that sub-command ONLY IF no modifying command also appears in its arguments or sibling statements. Entry forms: full path 'c:\temp\abc.ps1', partial path 'subdir\partial.ps1' (path-suffix match), or bare name 'barename.ps1' (basename match). Case-insensitive; '/' and '\' are equivalent.

PowerShell.description: Minimal PowerShell domain for the trusted_programs fixture (verb-based classification).
PowerShell._comment_tiers: Get-* => read-only (allow); Remove-*/Set-*/New-*/Copy-*/Move-* => modifying (ask). Empty pattern arrays; verbs decide.

Linux.description: Minimal Linux domain. NOTE: commands like '& c:\temp\abc.ps1 ...' detect as linux (the & + path prefix masks the Verb-Noun signal), so a Linux domain must exist for Resolve-Command to reach the program-token step. Its tiers are barely exercised here because a matched trusted_program short-circuits before them; the arg-scan re-detects arg-suffix domains (e.g. 'Remove-Item c:\temp' => powershell) independently.
